description: Allocation and management of authentication information is not controlled through a formal process.
applicability: Applies when an organization lacks formal processes for allocating, managing, and protecting authentication credentials including passwords, tokens, certificates, and biometric data, or when users can select weak credentials without enforcement.

metadata.detection_notes: Review password policies and enforcement, assess credential issuance procedures, verify secure credential storage and transmission, check for default or shared credentials, evaluate multi-factor authentication requirements, assess credential rotation practices.
